title: Texas Roadhouse rap
description: Come on in to TEXAS ROADHOUSE on BETHEL ROAD and see the cast! Always looking to hire new roadies to join the team! APPLY INSIDE!

asr.full_text: The following audio is currently not available to watch. Thank you for calling Texas Roadhouse on Bethel Road in Columbus, Ohio. We are currently closed. If you are calling for someone you believe is in the building at this time, please press 3. Get your feel good on a Roadhouse Get your feel good on the roadhouse Please stay seated when you pay 45 seconds to greet my table What she order? 12 filet Better open my section cause I'm already clocked Double seat me and we're having a talk 86 prime rib, haven't even hit the rush All I do is move these onions and mush Who's on glasses, who's on eyes? I'll check you out, just don't ask twice Sorry, gotta go, gotta get this Order in, scribbling fast Now my hair feels sore again Kitchen full blast, host stand gone crazy Lobby looking heavy but the weight don't phase me Faze me. Get your feel good on At Texas Roadhouse Yeah Got a lot of friends that I work with, right? Gonna try hard to describe them politely. Roadies are people, they're not just servers. So I'll say their names on this track that I'm murderin'. Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Murderin' Aaron Trepilowicz, fat tips, Allison Haslin, fly like Aladdin, she don't even need a rug. Ali wanna fix brains, paint my drugs, Carl and I the most legendary, like Markenzie and Simon Petty. Good friends, spin bars Vocabulary may see no end Mika Chu wiping brows off quicker than rare Steak, salt, thyme, fire, Pittsburgh Mama Bird still knows best Sally Howe and me Ashley Rae got hella personality Cable's a drummer, true story Ask Madison on a date, she'll ignore me Danielle Tulipano with the jet black hair Asked Misty for a pillow but she wouldn't share That's right, no hands pot I see but I just might Give a high five when I close for the night Or charge for a grenadine in a kid's sprite, upsold Yeah, better get a box cause I'm portioned to large Walking in alone but you're leaving with a baby Ordering mash pot, better get the gravy cause it Makes you slap your mama for not cooking like that at home Can't get your figure good enough At Texas R.O.W. Looking for a party, hit up Lizard, won't be sorry Seth 2, springtime, Halloween party Jesse Davis still doesn't eat any dairy Noah and Caitlyn soon getting married. Jake too but a brush with a diamond ring. Janelle kills it when she sings. Nathan looking like a model with the red hair. Nicki leaning hard but she don't need a chair. Victoria running trades for the lazy. Niecy Q but not as much as her baby. Right. I got the vibe of a really good brother. Teresa riding life as a really good mother. Christina still a model Bruce is YouTube, I will follow Holly, loving any taco In faith, Godstown, for days Brene, Miranda Friends like peaches in Atlanta Taryn and Flan, I'll pay CAC is a beast Sophia making laugh at the least Jerrard is a wild man He might need a leash And Joe is funny man Hannah from the east Amanda Seekerts, got stories on deck Jenni and Craig, are new but fresh Jordan making, bombs You might need a leash. Joe is a funny man. Hand him from the east. Amanda, Seeka's got stories on deck. Jenny and Greg are new but they fresh. Jordan making bombs and I think that's really hot. Rachel Maka, I gotta say, thank you for the shots. Adkins, you always do your side work, girl. and V on the ship, You're gonna take home the world. Makes you slap your mama. Four not, cooking like clocking out.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes a Texas Roadhouse location, its menu, and workplace camaraderie while inviting viewers to visit or apply for staff roles. The described hiring and food promotions are ordinary restaurant communications, with no observed request for investment, sensitive credentials, upfront payment, or deceptive off-platform participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content promotes a restaurant location and hiring, and sampled frames advertise restaurant food and a menu occasion. These are observed ordinary business and product promotions.
